entities.summary: Hasanmurod Qushbegi Mosque — a historical memorial site located in the city of Khiva in the Khorezm Region of Uzbekistan. The mosque was built in the late 18th to early 19th centuries near the ″Bogcha Gate″. The site is part of the Itchan Kala complex and is situated opposite the Amir Tura Madrasa.
